summary: Beaverhead NF lookout 17 miles NW of Wisdom: watched from at least 1940, 30-ft tower built 1952-53, staffed into the 1950s-60s, a 20-ft tower in 1964, gone by 1976.

facts.design: 30' pole L-4 tower (1953); 20' treated timber tower (1964)
facts.status_note: Gone. A 20-foot timber tower is listed for 1964; the site is listed as gone by 1976, and another listing says removed, with no date.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com dates the 30-foot tower to 1953. The 1952 and January 1953 newspaper items show work in autumn 1952 and completion by January 1953. The story gives 1952-53.
Firelookout.com gives 17 miles northwest of Wisdom; the 1952 paper gives 15 miles as the crow flies or 25 miles by trail. These are different measures.
The paper names both Bill Wilcox (July 1953) and Don Smith (September 1953) for the 1953 season and does not say how the season was divided.
The 30-foot (9.1 m) height is the 1953 tower. Firelookout.com lists a 20-foot tower for 1964; the record keeps the first tower's height.

notes_for_editor: Build year disagrees: firelookout.com says 1953; the newspaper items say work began in September 1952 and was complete by January 1953. The newspaper items are read through the Forest Lookouts transcription page, not from the original papers. The 1964 replacement and 1976 date appear only on firelookout.com. The record's 9.1 m height is the 1953 tower. No description of the site today or of current access was found. The firelookout.com page credits photos to Mike Barr, but no image URLs were found.
